config.micro_code:
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Bet Z2's compiled-caller micro. Used by jit_hooks.rb via micro_code; the
# same loop supplies the interpreter Callgrind window (second argument).
require "json"
require "digest"
abort "wrong JIT" unless RubyVM::ZJIT.enabled? == (ARGV.fetch(0) == "zjit")

def literal_keywords(a: 13, **kwargs)
  a + kwargs[:left] - kwargs[:right]
end

def hot_loop(n)
  i = 0
  total = 0
  while i < n
    total += literal_keywords(right: 3, a: 17, left: 29)
    i += 1
  end
  total
end

100.times { abort "wrong warmup" unless hot_loop(2_000) == 86_000 }
GC.start
n = ARGV[1] ? Integer(ARGV.fetch(1)) : 2_000_000
if ENV["LOWRAIL_CALLGRIND_EXT"]
  require ENV.fetch("LOWRAIL_CALLGRIND_EXT")
  GC.disable
end
before = RubyVM::ZJIT.stats if RubyVM::ZJIT.enabled? && ENV["Z2_STATS"]
objects = GC.stat(:total_allocated_objects)
started = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
LowrailCallgrindBench.start(false) if defined?(LowrailCallgrindBench)
result = hot_loop(n)
LowrailCallgrindBench.finish if defined?(LowrailCallgrindBench)
elapsed = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - started
objects = GC.stat(:total_allocated_objects) - objects
after = RubyVM::ZJIT.stats if before
abort "wrong result" unless result == 43 * n
puts JSON.generate(wall_seconds: elapsed, objects: objects, result: result,
  jit: RubyVM::ZJIT.enabled?, binary_sha256: Digest::SHA256.file("/proc/self/exe").hexdigest,
  ruby: RUBY_DESCRIPTION,
  jit_delta: before && after.select { |_, v| v.is_a?(Numeric) }.to_h { |k, v| [k, v - before.fetch(k, 0)] })

interpreter_ir.explanation: The entire initial -8 Ir/call difference is in unchanged hash.c::any_hash: positive-hash sign normalization executes two extra machine instructions, four times per call. Fixed getrandom bytes keep Ruby's private startup hash salt equal. This shim is NOT used in elapsed, stats or app runs; it destroys randomness and must never be used in an app/production.
interpreter_ir.gc: Disabled only in interpreter Callgrind micro after warmup; N=0 seam retained.

extra_validation.source:
require "json"
def mark(value)
  $effects << value
  value
end
def target(lead, a = mark(11), b = mark(23), *rest, post, required:, x: mark(31), y: mark(43), **kw)
  [lead, a, b, rest, post, required, x, y, kw.to_a, kw.default, kw.default_proc, kw.frozen?]
end
def anonymous(*, **kw) = kw.to_a
def plain(**kw) = kw.to_a
def forwarded(a: mark(53), **) = [a, plain(**)]
variants = [
  "target(3, 7, z: mark(59), required: mark(61), q: mark(67))",
  "target(3, 13, 7, y: mark(71), required: mark(73), z: mark(79))",
  "target(3, 13, 17, 7, x: mark(83), required: mark(89), q: mark(97))",
  "target(3, 13, 17, 19, 29, 7, z: mark(101), y: mark(103), required: mark(107), q: mark(109))",
  "target(3, 7, x: mark(113), required: mark(127), y: mark(131))",
  "target(3, 7, z: mark(137), x: mark(139))",
  "target(3, required: mark(149), q: mark(151))",
  "anonymous(z: mark(157), q: mark(163))",
  "plain(z: mark(167), q: mark(173))",
  "forwarded(z: mark(179), a: mark(181), q: mark(191))",
  "forwarded(z: mark(193), q: mark(197))",
  "plain(**{z: mark(199), q: mark(211)})",
  "plain(*[], z: mark(223), q: mark(227))",
  "plain(z: mark(229), q: mark(233), &nil)"
]
variants.each_with_index { |source, i| eval("def call_#{i}; #{source}; rescue ArgumentError => e; [e.class.name, e.message]; end") }
receipts = variants.each_index.map do |i|
  outcomes = 100.times.map do
    $effects = []
    value = send("call_#{i}")
    [value, $effects]
  end
  abort "unstable case #{i}" unless outcomes.uniq.size == 1
  outcomes.first
end
GC.verify_compaction_references(double_heap: true, toward: :empty)
puts JSON.generate(receipts)
